name: Inktrons #0159
description: Keeping the book honest. Inktrons #0159 is an Uncommon Quadwall Quartz, a four-screen monitor wall with a trading console, finished in Forest Gold. Its screens stream MSTR (Strategy) with mirrored depth bars pulsing on both sides of the book alongside candle chart, auction clock, line + volume, worked by a numeric keypad punching in orders. It comes with an antenna on top, a coin stack at its side and a filing cabinet in the corner. Set on a Solid platform against a soft ink glow. ERC404 on Ink, one of 180.
